Topics · Hard times

How do I live with worry about the future?

No promise that worry vanishes. Ease is with hardship, not after. One small step today, then turn to God.

If you are in pain right now, you do not have to carry it alone. Please reach out to someone you trust, or to a local crisis line or emergency number. Find a helpline near you

Part 1 of 3

﴿فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا٥ إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا٦﴾

Translation of the meaning

For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease [i.e., relief]. Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.

Quran · Ash-Sharh 94:5-6

Translation

Yahweh my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me. Yahweh, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit. Sing praise to Yahweh, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name. For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

Original · Hebrew

יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֑י שִׁוַּ֥עְתִּי אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ וַתִּרְפָּאֵֽנִי׃ יְֽהוָ֗ה הֶֽעֱלִ֣יתָ מִן־שְׁא֣וֹל נַפְשִׁ֑י חִ֝יִּיתַ֗נִי מִיָּֽרְדִי־בֽוֹר׃ זַמְּר֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חֲסִידָ֑יו וְ֝הוֹד֗וּ לְזֵ֣כֶר קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃ כִּ֤י רֶ֨גַע ׀ בְּאַפּוֹ֮ חַיִּ֪ים בִּרְצ֫וֹנ֥וֹ בָּ֭עֶרֶב יָלִ֥ין בֶּ֗כִי וְלַבֹּ֥קֶר רִנָּֽה׃

the Psalms · 30:2-5

World English Bible

The verse does not say hardship is absent. It says that with hardship there is ease, and it says so twice. The repeat is not decoration. It is like someone holding your hand and saying: with, with. The word is 'with', not 'after'. So the ease is not postponed to after the worry; it walks beside it. The verse does not say how or when.

A question for you

What worries you most?

If you sayWhat will become of me.
ThenThat question is human. The next step looks at what can be done today, not at everything at once.
If you sayThat everyone is worried, so no one can help.
ThenPerhaps no one can solve the future. But sitting beside someone in the worry eases it.
If you saySome days I do not want to go on.
ThenThis app cannot hear you or reach anyone for you, so please do not carry this alone. Talk today to someone you trust, a doctor, or a helpline where you live, and if you are in danger now, reach for the nearest person who can help. This verse is for you.

Part 2 of 3

﴿يَـٰبَنِىَّ ٱذْهَبُوا۟ فَتَحَسَّسُوا۟ مِن يُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ وَلَا تَا۟يْـَٔسُوا۟ مِن رَّوْحِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يَا۟يْـَٔسُ مِن رَّوْحِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

O my sons, go and find out about Joseph and his brother and despair not of relief from Allāh. Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allāh except the disbelieving people."

Quran · Yusuf 12:87

Translation

David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let us fall now into Yahweh’s hand, for his mercies are great. Let me not fall into man’s hand.”

Original · Hebrew

וַיֹּ֧אמֶר דָּוִ֛ד אֶל־גָּ֖ד צַר־לִ֣י מְאֹ֑ד נִפְּלָה־נָּ֤א בְיַד־יְהוָה֙ כִּֽי־רַבִּ֣ים רַֽחֲמָ֔יו וּבְיַד־אָדָ֖ם אַל־אֶפֹּֽלָה׃

2 Samuel · 24:14

World English Bible

Jacob says to his sons: go and look into news of Joseph and his brother, and do not despair of God's relief. Two sentences in one breath: do something, and do not despair. Hope in the verse is not only waiting. It is going out and looking. A small step today is truer than a large plan for tomorrow.

A question for you

What is closest to what you need?

If you sayA small step.
ThenThat is what the father says in the verse. Choose it, and give it half an hour.
If you sayTo breathe and pause.
ThenPausing is a kind of hope too. The next verse will wait for you.
If you sayI fear nothing will help.
ThenThat fear is honest. The verse does not promise the result, only that we not despair.

Part 3 of 3

﴿فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ٧ وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب٨﴾

Translation of the meaning

So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship]. And to your Lord direct [your] longing.

Quran · Ash-Sharh 94:7-8

Translation

Yes, in the way of your judgments, Yahweh, we have waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul. With my soul I have desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me I will seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are on the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.

Original · Hebrew

אַ֣ף אֹ֧רַח מִשְׁפָּטֶ֛יךָ יְהוָ֖ה קִוִּינ֑וּךָ לְשִׁמְךָ֥ וּֽלְזִכְרְךָ֖ תַּאֲוַת־נָֽפֶשׁ׃ נַפְשִׁ֤י אִוִּיתִ֨יךָ֙ בַּלַּ֔יְלָה אַף־רוּחִ֥י בְקִרְבִּ֖י אֲשַֽׁחֲרֶ֑ךָּ כִּ֞י כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר מִשְׁפָּטֶ֨יךָ֙ לָאָ֔רֶץ צֶ֥דֶק לָמְד֖וּ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵֽל׃

Isaiah · 26:8-9

World English Bible

After the two lines on ease come two more: when you have finished, stand up for what comes next, and turn with longing to your Lord. Finish one thing, rise to the next, then turn your heart. They do not ask you to solve all of tomorrow. They give a rhythm: a small work, then turning. A rhythm is lighter than a plan.

A question for you

Which rhythm suits you?

If you sayI work, then pause.
ThenThat is close to the verse's rhythm.
If you sayI pause first, then work.
ThenThe verse begins with being free, so there is no fault if you begin with a pause.
If you sayI do not know.
ThenTry one week with whatever comes easily. And return to this page if you wish.

The same in the other books

Translation
